# VaultScaler

> VaultScaler builds Forgewing, the Product Delivery Engine. Founded in 2025, launching June 2026.

VaultScaler builds Forgewing, the Product Delivery Engine that lets product-and-engineering teams ship together. The company's tagline is "Build More. Manage Less."

## Products

### Forgewing
Forgewing is the Product Delivery Engine. Point it at your repo or hand it a brief — it designs the architecture, returns real pull requests, deploys to your AWS account, and operates the system after launch. Engineering keeps review and merge authority. The product uses a persistent artifact called the mission brief — a living spec that captures every requirement, decision, and reasoning before code is written. Forgewing also runs an operational-memory graph that captures every decision and incident, compounding institutional knowledge across each customer's product surfaces.

- Product page: https://vaultscaler.com/forgewing/
- Differentiators: Product-and-engineering pod buyer (not engineer-only), real pull requests against customer repos, customer-owned AWS deployments, operations included after launch, operational-memory graph
- Target customers: Startup pods (solo founders through Series A), and forward-deployed product+engineering pods inside larger orgs

### Radix Core (secondary product)
Radix Core is a GPU training optimization platform that uses closed-loop control to balance memory, compute, and power across training runs. It delivers up to 21% throughput improvement over standard FIFO scheduling (based on VaultScaler internal benchmarks). Deploys via Helm chart on Kubernetes 1.26+ with zero changes to existing training code or stack. Originally built for air-gapped deployment with zero egress. SLSA Level 3 attestations. Pricing is $45 per GPU per month with a 14-day free trial (up to 400 GPUs). Hyperscale pricing available for 1,000+ GPU deployments.

- Product page: https://vaultscaler.com/radix/core/
- Differentiators: Closed-loop multi-dimensional scheduling (memory + compute + power), air-gapped/zero-egress ready, SLSA Level 3, no stack changes required
- Target customers: ML/AI teams running GPU training clusters on Kubernetes

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is VaultScaler?
VaultScaler is the company behind Forgewing, the Product Delivery Engine. VaultScaler also builds Radix Core, a GPU training optimizer. Forgewing launches June 2026.

### What is Forgewing?
Forgewing is the Product Delivery Engine — point it at your repo or hand it a brief, and it designs, builds, deploys to your AWS, and operates the system after launch. Engineering keeps review and merge authority over every pull request.

### How is Forgewing different from Cursor, Copilot, Kiro, or Devin?
Those tools generate code and stop. Forgewing owns delivery — collaborative brief through deployment and production operations. The buyer is the product-and-engineering pod, not engineering alone.

### What is Radix Core?
Radix Core is a GPU training optimization platform that uses closed-loop scheduling to improve training throughput by up to 21%. It deploys via Helm chart on Kubernetes with zero stack changes and supports air-gapped environments.

### What does Radix Core cost?
Radix Core costs $45 per GPU per month. A free 14-day trial is available for up to 400 GPUs. Custom pricing is available for deployments of 1,000+ GPUs.
